title: WaveStrap 1.4.1: Crash fix
body: Roblox could crash on launch when Vulkan rendering was forced. WaveStrap now switches risky graphics options back to Automatic if Roblox crashes.

title: WaveStrap 1.4: Font library
body: Pick from 12 built-in fonts with live previews and real bold text, or import your own. Plus an optional server location notice when you join a game.

title: WaveStrap 1.3: Performance boosts
body: New Performance section with one-click Max performance, plus stretched resolution that works on more PCs: pick your monitor, keep your refresh rate, test before you play.

title: WaveStrap 1.2: Stretched resolution
body: Play Roblox stretched (like 1440x1080) without touching your desktop: WaveStrap switches only while Roblox is open and restores your normal resolution when it closes.

title: WaveStrap 1.1: 12 new mods & Experiences
body: New Experiences page with favorites and recently played, custom sounds with preview, volume and window presets, launcher themes with an editor, mod updates, rollback, backups and an import wizard.
